name: AirGuard AI - Daily Air Quality Action Agent Flow
description: Agentic RAG pipeline converting AQI data and personal context into daily actionable recommendations using IBM Granite 4.0 8B Instruct and Chroma Vector Store.

data.label: Chat Input
data.description: Accepts user location, AQI, age, activity, commute method, and outdoor exposure duration.

data.label: File Loader
data.description: Loads the curated air quality guideline document for RAG retrieval.

data.label: Text Splitter
data.description: Splits guidelines into chunks for vector indexing.

data.label: Text Embedder
data.description: Converts knowledge chunks into high-dimensional vector representations.

data.label: Vector Store (ChromaDB)
data.description: Stores guideline embeddings for similarity search.

data.label: RAG Retriever
data.description: Retrieves top 3 relevant guidelines matching the user's AQI and activity query.

data.label: Agentic Prompt Template
data.template:
You are AirGuard AI, an intelligent air-quality action planning assistant.

User input: {user_input}
Retrieved Guidelines: {context}

Tasks:
1. Analyze AQI severity & Personal Exposure Score (AQI x Hours).
2. Provide structured TODAY'S ACTION PLAN for exercise, commute, and windows.
3. Give personalized health advisories.
4. Provide 1 actionable community recommendation.

Structure response cleanly with headers.
data.description: Combines user context and RAG retrieved context for model execution.

data.label: IBM Granite 4.0 8B Instruct
data.description: Instruction-tuned reasoning LLM producing structured action plans.

data.label: Chat Output
data.description: Displays the final personalized daily action plan to the user.
